notes.approach: Formed LEVEL IS YOU in Fragile Existence and tested movement and entry, then returned to the overworld to test whether control persisted there.
notes.mechanics: One UP moved the room and fixed words upward by 24 logical pixels; the controlled key and blue object moved upward by 48 absolute pixels, or 24 relative to the room. Return did not enter another level. On the overworld, moving BABA down broke BABA IS YOU. The following LEFT produced no movement, disproving the tested prediction that LEVEL IS YOU would preserve control after leaving the level in this test.

notes.approach: Rebuilt our Hostile Environment setup, used the moving Keke to clear the LEVEL rule and recreate Baba, then carried FLAG into LEVEL IS FLAG.
